result:
Round 236 is planned and ready for A. The decision is **CONTINUE**, and `store/` was not touched: HEAD is still `49b4c74`, the tree is clean, and the frozen-file hashes match.

**Round 235 result:** C passed it in a real browser (19 rows) and the gate published it as `49b4c74`. That completes SABA-B-11a (tempo from the asset's BPM, plus the interactive bars ruler). In the backlog (v221) and the feature-status board it is now marked done (მზადაა).

**Round 236 (SABA-B-11a-FIX-1)** fixes three bugs in the code that plays from a click on the ruler's top strip:
- **GATE235-S1 (Medium):** double-clicking the strip starts playback and also zooms the view to fit the whole project. After the fix, a strip double-click only plays. The lower part of the ruler still fits the view.
  - In Chromium the double-click event arrives at the ruler, not the strip, because the ruler captures the pointer. So the fix uses where the press started, and I added a test that fails if someone uses the event target instead.
  - Saba gets one question on this: SABA-Q-SCRUB-DOUBLE-CLICK.
- **A-R235-REVIEW-M1 (Medium, not yet seen in the browser):** the "start or not" check can read an outdated playing state and stop playback instead of starting it. A new `playFrom` in `ArrangementContext` reads the live playing flag instead.
- **C-R235-01 (Low, fixed now because it is the same function):** a click that snaps to the project end used to play from 0. Now it shows the existing "past the end" message and does not play. Space at the end still plays from 0.

The task changes 5 files plus a new doc 184; every other tracked file is frozen. I tried the change on a scratch copy first:
- **Covering tests:** all 118 test files that touch this code passed (1,692 tests). Type-check and Biome were clean.
- **New tests:** each of the three new tests fails when its fix is removed.
- **Browser:** the before/after checks ran in Chromium at both screen sizes, on the current build and on the scratch copy.

**New finding:** the seed-status bug A-R234-REVIEW-M1 *does* happen in `/studio-lab`, contrary to the earlier note. If a sound is added within about 1–2 s of page load, the "Demo collection ready" message overwrites the tempo message. I recorded the general case as B-R235-READY-CLOBBER. Round 237 (SABA-B-11a-FIX-2) covers it together with GATE234-S2 and S3, still before SABA-B-11b. Because of this, C's checks now wait for the "ready" message before adding a sound.

**Other decisions:**
- **C-R235-02 (Follow on ruler clicks):** I moved it into SABA-B-10a rather than this round. It would have been a fourth item in a three-item round, and 10a redefines the same click anyway. The task lists it as a temporary deviation.
- **Lessons:** added lesson L48. It covers the 50 ms delay before playback starts and the wait for "ready". `lessons.md` is now 58 lines.
- **Small items:** two Lows went to the deferred polish list (GATE235-S4-KEY-ORDER and B-R236-END-WORDING).
- **Architecture:** the gate's note about where a shared pointer helper lives was added as an addendum to the existing tempo/grid checkpoint request. It is not scheduled as work.

**For root:**
- `docs/technical/studio-real-workspace/agent-workflow.md` on disk is older than the policy in this run's prompt: it stops at the "Loop v2" section. I followed the prompt's newer version; the file needs to be brought up to date.
- Please run the checkpoint request in `b-round-234-checkpoint-request.md` before SABA-B-11b. Its answer shapes round 237's fix.

**Timing:** the next regression round is due on or after 2026-10-30, and the next retro at round 245. Saba has not answered any open question yet, including the SABA-B-7 envelope note.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. On its final review I changed one acceptance row: I checked `resolveActiveLoop` in the source, and the row now cites it.
